# Recent teaching

My courses connect macroeconomic models and ideas with reproducible empirical work, primarily using Matlab, R and public international datasets.

## Empirical Macroeconomics

Macroeconomic measurement and comparison using Eurostat, OECD, World Bank, and FRED data. Topics include growth, inflation, labor markets, productivity, and monetary integration. In Hungarian.

[Syllabus](files/syllabus_empirical.pdf)

## Advanced Macroeconomics

Modern macroeconomic models, quantitative methods, and applications to policy questions.

[Syllabus](/files/syllabus_macro.pdf)

## Economics of Underdevelopment

A policy-oriented course on the many aspects of underdevelopment, using basci economic reasoning and stylized facts. 

[Syllabus](files/syllabus_underdevelopment.pdf)
